items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: He played with Piron, the fellas, see, long before I thought about playing.

ctx.x: Piron. He played with Piron, the fellas, see, long before I thought about playing. But we went to school together in the third and fourth grade. Then there was Humphrey, Willie Humphrey, Willie Humphrey. The reason I'm breaking up some of these fellas, Bill, while reading the book that you gave me, I noted in there, I think it was Dominic who said that the musicians downtown read and
the musicians in downtown didn't read.
